description: A single white sheet of paper lies on a pink fabric surface, with a light cloth backdrop behind it. The left hand reaches in from the left and the right hand from the right to grasp opposite edges of the paper as a two-hand object, lifting and aligning it, then folding the top portion down toward the bottom to make a long horizontal fold; both hands press and smooth along the crease, and the right hand briefly lifts and adjusts the edge before flattening it again while the left hand steadies the paper as a left-hand object.
